scope: Three priority scenes requested by the owner; not the full eight-image campaign

visualDirection.palette: Piankexun warm gold, ivory and dark ink; no competitor artwork
visualDirection.layout: Large Chinese benefit headline, full query callout and untouched native screenshot crop. An original source photo may be enlarged separately only after its actual first-result match is reviewed, explicitly labelled outside the app UI.
visualDirection.restriction: Never replace the query or reorder, insert, remove or fabricate app results

scenes.headline: 记得那个时刻，就能开始找
scenes.query: 傍晚的海边，粉紫色和橙色的天空，两个人站在水边，身后有一座长长的栈桥
scenes.acceptance: Actual Chinese query visible in the UI or recorded AX; sunset photo first, with distractors in the indexed library. Full query repeated outside the screenshot only if the same query was truly entered.
scenes.limitation: Apple Translation is unavailable on the simulator. This pilot tests raw Chinese retrieval, not the unavailable translation path. If relevance fails, require a real-device shoot rather than substituting English results.

scenes.headline: 证件照片，不必翻遍相册
scenes.acceptance: OCR is off. Multiple distinct fictional card photos should lead the actual semantic results; do not mislabel OCR matches as semantic recognition.
scenes.limitation: Prominently identify original mock cards as demo samples. No real personal information, valid ID numbers, official seals, national emblem or government-issued replica. Mock success does not prove performance on every real document.

scenes.headline: 记住一段文字，也能找到照片
scenes.acceptance: Four menus share layout but contain distinct small-print delivery locations. Preserve all four before/after searches and actual eleven-photo OCR completion evidence. Adopt only a query whose intended menu improves to first with OCR enabled; if the before result is already first, that query cannot prove OCR dependence.
scenes.limitation: This is an original fictitious order/menu, not a customer's receipt or private screenshot.
